content: पञ्चम {%a.%} (-मी|{%f.%}) .²1 The fifth. .²2 Forming a fifth part. .²3 Dexterous, clever. .²4 Beautiful, brilliant. .{@-मः@} .²1 The fifth (or in later times the seventh) note of the Indian gamut; it is said to be produced by the cuckoo (कोकिलो रौति पञ्चमम् <ls>Nārada.</ls>), and is so called because it is produced from 5 parts of the body:-- वायुः समुद्गतो नभिरुरोहृत्कण्ठमूर्धसु . विचरन् पञ्चमस्थानप्राप्त्या पञ्चम उच्यते ... .²2 <ab>N.</ab> of a Rāga or musical mode (sung in the above note); व्यथयति वृथा मौनं तन्वि प्रपञ्चय पञ्चमम् <ls>Gīt. 10</ls>; so उदञ्चितपञ्चमरागम् <ls>Gīt. 1</ls>. .²3 The fifth consonant of a class; {%<ab>i. e.</ab>%} a nasal. .{@-मम्@} .²1 A fifth. .²2 Sexual intercourse (मैथुन), the fifth मकार of the Tāntrikas. .{@-मम्@} {%ind.%} For the fifth time, fifthly; <ls>Ms. 8. 125</ls>. .{@-मी@} .²1 The fifth day of a lunar fortnight. .²2 The ablative case (in <ab>gram.</ab>). .²3 An epithet of Draupadī. .²4 A chequered board for playing at draughts.
